profile.name: Reni Calonge
profile.summary: Full-stack developer with 10 years of experience in .NET applications, frontend development, cloud integrations, and database optimization. I work across C#, Angular, Blazor, SQL, Azure, and AWS, with experience in Agile delivery, clean architecture, system migrations, and production support.

projects.title: Health Declaration
projects.description: A health declaration project from my PowerApps collection.

projects.title: Parking Backend & Admin
projects.description: A Switzerland-based parking application with backend services and an Angular administration interface for parking operations.
projects.contribution: Maintained and enhanced the .NET Core and Angular application. Implemented Azure AD B2C authentication, background parking processing, and Google Pub/Sub integration for boom barriers. Supported multilingual interfaces with i18n and Lokalise and maintained SendGrid email templates.
projects.decisions: Used background services for parking processing and Google Pub/Sub for barrier integration. Added Postman Collection Runner tests and health checks, with service monitoring through Grafana Loki.

projects.title: Insurance Electronic App
projects.description: A web-based insurance application that automates agent workflows through dynamic questionnaires and printable PDF applications.
projects.contribution: Contributed to dynamic questionnaires and user/question management. Implemented conditional question flow based on earlier responses and answer-to-form mapping for ready-to-submit printable PDF insurance applications.
projects.decisions: Applied rule-based conditional logic to questionnaire flow and resolved code issues identified through Application Insights.

projects.title: Maritime Customer Portal
projects.description: A maritime management portal with secure user access, embedded financial and performance reporting, and automated email notifications.
projects.contribution: Delivered the portal from the ground up using ASP.NET MVC. Implemented authentication and user management with ASP.NET Identity, embedded Power BI reports, and automated notifications with SMTP Client.
projects.decisions: Embedded Power BI financial and performance reports in the application so users could view, print, and export insights.

projects.title: Data Auto Mapper
projects.description: A data mapping project from my C# portfolio.

projects.title: E-commerce / Shopping Cart
projects.description: An award-winning e-commerce and shopping cart system developed as a thesis project by a three-person team and adopted by the client.
projects.contribution: Served as technical lead for a three-person thesis team, leading technical direction and taking responsibility for the system architecture and interface layout design.
projects.decisions: Defined the system architecture and designed the application layouts.
projects.outcome: The project won the Best Thesis award and was adopted and used by the client.

experience.title: Senior Backend Engineer
experience.details:
Maintained and enhanced a multinational microservice-based e-commerce platform, including OZSALE and NZSALE.
Developed secure SOAP and REST APIs using .NET and .NET Core for web and mobile teams; migrated legacy .NET Framework applications to .NET Core.
Supported database migrations from AWS EC2 to RDS and performed database optimization and query tuning.
Integrated AWS Lambda, SQS, SNS, and EventBridge, plus Azure Event Hub and Service Bus.
Built and maintained TeamCity and Octopus Deploy pipelines; provided production support and monitoring using New Relic.
Maintained Insider and Elasticsearch integrations, internal NuGet packages and shared libraries, and console automation tools.
Maintained and enhanced payment gateway integrations with Stripe, Braintree, PayPal, and Afterpay.

experience.title: Full Stack .NET Developer
experience.details:
Nursing assessment: maintained a US-based .NET Core and Angular/TypeScript platform; migrated ASP.NET WebForms toward microservices and Angular, and transitioned VM workloads to Kubernetes with Docker.
Integrated a chatbot widget and AI prompt/payload/response processing using Kafka; built question types with micro-frontends, Module Federation, and an internal Material UI component library. Implemented LaunchDarkly feature flags with proxy support.
Troubleshot GitLab CI/CD and Kubernetes, monitored with Datadog and Rancher, managed releases and documentation, exported score reports to PDF and Excel, and handled ServiceNow change and support requests.
ERP: enhanced a Blazor WebAssembly solution with HR and Accounting modules and reusable dynamic components. Integrated Azure Data Factory ingestion into Snowflake, implemented Microsoft Graph role-based authorization, and improved development and CI/CD processes.
E-Kanban: delivered an ASP.NET Core/Razor Pages inventory system for a Germany-based pharmaceutical company with QR generation/scanning, MSAL token refresh, Microsoft Graph authorization, Azure App Service, and GitHub Actions deployment through Azure Virtual Desktop.
Parking: maintained a Switzerland-based .NET Core and Angular application; implemented Azure AD B2C authentication, parking background processing, Google Pub/Sub barrier integration, i18n/Lokalise, and SendGrid templates. Created Postman Collection Runner tests and health checks and monitored with Grafana Loki.
Legal assessment: enhanced an ASP.NET MVC platform, worked with a third party toward WCAG certification, secured file handling with Scanii, and integrated Azure Functions for dynamic scoring.
Insurance: contributed to a .NET Core application with dynamic questionnaires, user/question management, conditional question flow, answer-to-form mapping for printable PDF applications, and remediation of issues identified through Application Insights.
Data gathering and engagement: delivered a .NET Core and Angular platform with role-based access restrictions, My Busy Bee SMS campaigns, and Chart.js reporting dashboards.
Maritime: delivered an ASP.NET MVC management portal with ASP.NET Identity, embedded Power BI financial/performance reports with print/export functionality, and automated SMTP notifications.

Developed Sawtooth surveys with Perl logic scripts.
Deployed and configured .NET applications in IIS; administered SQL Server queries and stored procedures.
Remotely administered servers and investigated performance and heavy load.

experience.title: Digital Developer

Integrated video-engagement and advertising metrics tracking; ensured mobile responsiveness and cross-browser compatibility.

experience.title: Junior Programmer
experience.details:
Developed web and Windows point-of-sale modules and supported a real-time web bidding platform.
Designed interfaces and automated POS configuration; improved website security and supported technical discussions and API integrations.

experience.title: Technical Support
